title: Eli And The Thirteenth Confession
notes:
First pressing "360 SOUND STEREO" labels.
Columbia, Terre Haute pressing.
Issued with fold-over lyric sheet.

According to the documentary "Inventing David Geffen", Nyro wanted the LP to smell like lilacs, so Geffen (who was her manager) was able to convince Columbia to use lilac-scented ink for the lyric sheet.

Runouts are stamped
